Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Orion Cochlear Implant is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5T and 3T
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 2,500 gauss/cm
RF Transmit Coil Type Body transmit coil or head transmit coil
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg ≤ 1.2 W/kg
Head SAR ≤ 3.2 W/kg not specified
Maximum active scan time not specified 10 minutes
Wait time between sessions not specified 15 minutes
Device Configuration Therapy OFF
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
